title: Halting configurations are fixed
statement: Let $N$ be a nondeterministic oracle Turing machine, $O$ an oracle language, $b$ a choice bit, and $c$ a configuration with no state. Then the step of $N$ from $c$ using choice $b$ relative to $O$ leaves $c$ unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $k$ of ordinary work tapes
A state type and symbol type
A configuration with $k+1$ work tapes whose state is absent
